claim.quote: We report the first observation of Negative Ion Drift (NID) at surface pressure of $900 \pm 7$ mbar at Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso in a He:CF$_4$:SF$_6$ mixture using an optically read out Time Projection Chamber (TPC) within the CYGNO/INITIUM project.

name: First Optical Observation of Negative Ion Drift at Surface Pressure

summary.plain: Within the CYGNO/INITIUM project, a gas chamber at Gran Sasso showed for the first time, with optical readout, charges drifting as negative ions at normal atmospheric pressure, which could allow larger, sharper optical detectors.
summary.technical: He:CF4:SF6 mixture at 900 +/- 7 mbar with an optically read out TPC (MANGO detector); first PMT waveform analysis in the NID regime; minority charge carrier drifting ~25% faster than the dominant SF6- species.

title: First Optical Observation of Negative Ion Drift at Surface Pressure
why_it_matters: The abstract says the results open a concrete path toward large-scale, low-diffusion optical TPCs for rare event searches.
